program='''from collections import Counter, deque\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    seen = set()\n    comps = []\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r,c) in seen:\n                continue\n            q = [(r,c)]\n            seen.add((r,c))\n            comp = []\n            while q:\n                y,x = q.pop()\n                comp.append((y,x,grid[y][x]))\n                for ny,nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):\n                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != bg and (ny,nx) not in seen:\n                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))\n            comps.append(comp)\n    template = max(comps, key=len)\n    tr0=min(y for y,x,v in template); tr1=max(y for y,x,v in template)\n    tc0=min(x for y,x,v in template); tc1=max(x for y,x,v in template)\n    ar=(tr0+tr1)//2; ac=(tc0+tc1)//2\n    markers=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and all((r,c)!=(y,x) for y,x,v in template)]\n    out=[row[:] for row in grid]\n    for r,c in markers:\n        out[r][c]=bg\n        for y,x,v in template:\n            yy,xx=r+(y-ar),c+(x-ac)\n            if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w:\n                out[yy][xx]=v\n    return out\n'''
